pageTitle: Infrastructure monitoring hosted in Saudi Arabia
headline: Every network, server and application in one view — with data that never leaves the Kingdom.
sub: {{brand}} unifies network, server, application and log monitoring for Saudi organisations. Arabic-first and supported locally during your working hours.

login.title: Sign in to the demo console
login.subtitle: Any e-mail and password will work — this is a demo environment.
login.remember: Data shown after sign-in is generated in your browser.
login.sso: Single sign-on (SSO) available in the Enterprise plan

pillars.title: Built for how Saudi IT teams work

residency.title: 100% hosted in Saudi Arabia
residency.body: Metrics, logs and alerts are stored and processed in Riyadh and Jeddah data centers. Nothing is replicated abroad.

regulatory.title: Designed for local regulation
regulatory.body: Controls and reports designed to support alignment with NCA ECC, PDPL and SAMA requirements.

arabic.title: Arabic-first, fully bilingual
arabic.body: A true right-to-left interface, Arabic reports and alerts, Hijri and Gregorian dates, Riyadh time.

support.title: Local support, your hours
support.body: Engineers in the Kingdom, available Sunday to Thursday during Saudi business hours, in Arabic or English.

coverage.title: One platform instead of four tools
coverage.networkBody: Routers, switches, firewalls, Wi-Fi, WAN links and carriers
coverage.serversBody: Physical hosts, VMs, databases, UPS and facilities
coverage.appsBody: Response time, error rates and service dependencies
coverage.logsBody: Searchable, live log stream including Arabic-language entries

finalCta.title: Help shape a Saudi-built monitoring platform
finalCta.body: We are onboarding a small group of pilot customers. Tell us about your environment and your biggest monitoring challenge.
